decisions.why: Aura Plus closed/convex bags and stoma cap are colostomy bags
CliniShield skin cleansers, barrier creams and barrier films and LBF barrier cream are stoma/skin-care accessories, not continence catheter/drainage devices
Aura urostomy bag variants are explicitly urostomy bags
Aura drainable bag variants are explicitly ileostomy/drainable bags
HyperSeal, Welland stoma paste and flange extenders are stoma accessories and seals
night and leg drainage bags are drainage bags & valves
Appeel adhesive removers are stoma skin-care accessories
deodorant spray and motion management sachets are stoma accessories
LBF sterile barrier film is a stoma skin-care accessory/seal
Tensi+ is CliniMed's electrical stimulation product line for pelvic floor therapy, matching pelvic health and urogynaecology
